floater.name: prestige_quick_library
floater.title: Quick library
floater.string: Showing the first [SHOWN] of [TOTAL] items. Type more to narrow the list.
There is no "Prestige Library" folder yet.
(Very large inventory: only part of it is searched.)
No matching items. Try other words or tick more types.
Nothing used from this window yet.
Click "Create library folder" to make a "Prestige Library" folder at the top of My Inventory, then put items or links in it.

filter_editor.label: Search by name
filter_editor.name: search
filter_editor.tool_tip: Shows the items whose name contains this text (upper and lower case are the same). Up / Down choose a result, Enter opens it.

combo_box.name: scope
combo_box.tool_tip: Search all of My Inventory, or only the "Prestige Library" folder at its top (links in that folder count too).

check_box.name: favorites_only
check_box.label: Favourites
check_box.tool_tip: Only your inventory favourites (the same ones as the inventory's Favorites), and the items in favourite folders.

check_box.name: recent_only
check_box.label: Recent
check_box.tool_tip: Only the last 20 items you opened, wore or dragged out from this window, newest first.

button.name: create_folder
button.label: Create library folder
button.tool_tip: Make a folder called "Prestige Library" at the top of My Inventory. Put the items (or links to them) you use most in it.

prestige_quick_library_list.name: results
prestige_quick_library_list.tool_tip: Double-click or Enter opens an item as the inventory does. Drag a row into the world to rez an object, onto a face to apply a texture or material, or onto an object or avatar.

button.name: open
button.label: Open
button.tool_tip: Open the selected item as the inventory does (preview, editor, wear, teleport offer, activate gesture).

button.name: favorite
button.label: Favourite
button.tool_tip: Add the selected item to your inventory favourites, or remove it.

button.name: show_in_inventory
button.label: Show in inventory
button.tool_tip: Open the inventory at the selected item.
